categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of honeycomb ceramic products primarily used for air pollution control. Its main products include honeycomb ceramic carriers for vehicle exhaust after-treatment systems such as DOC, SCR, ASC, TWC, DPF, ACT-DPF, SiC-DPF, and GPF, as well as energy-saving regenerative bodies for industrial applications. It also produces VOCs treatment equipment and energy-saving heat storage bodies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has proprietary core technologies centered on andesine material structure and crystallization control, and high-performance honeycomb ceramic carrier preparation processes. It integrates formula design, precision mold manufacturing, and kiln firing temperature field control to produce large-size honeycomb ceramic carriers with ultra-low thermal expansion coefficients and high durability. The production involves complex multi-step processes including extrusion molding, drying, firing, and precise kiln temperature control, supported by advanced equipment and automated control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are catalyst coating manufacturers serving vehicle manufacturers, especially in the commercial heavy-duty truck segment, as well as companies in the aftermarket and marine engine sectors. The company serves domestic clients and exports to markets including the United States, Canada, South Korea, and India. Its products are critical for compliance with stringent vehicle emission standards such as China’s National VI and upcoming Euro 7 standards.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shandong (headquarters), Chongqing, Anhui, and other regions. It has established sales and service networks domestically and internationally, with export sales to North America, Europe, and Asia. The company’s subsidiaries cover key industrial regions in China, facilitating proximity to major automotive and catalyst manufacturers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive emission control supply chain, manufacturing core ceramic substrates used in exhaust after-treatment systems. It supplies these substrates to catalyst coating companies and system integrators who then supply automotive OEMs and aftermarket customers. It also engages in upstream raw material procurement and downstream direct sales to catalyst manufacturers and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in honeycomb ceramic materials and manufacturing processes to meet evolving emission standards such as China’s National VI and upcoming Euro 7. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on raw material localization, cost reduction, product performance enhancement, and production process optimization. It collaborates with universities and research institutes on national key projects and holds numerous patents, emphasizing technology leadership and sustainable development aligned with carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of honeycomb ceramic carriers and related pollution control products to domestic and international customers. The company employs both domestic direct sales and export sales models, including Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) and non-VMI modes for overseas customers. Revenue recognition is based on transfer of control upon delivery or customer acceptance, depending on contract terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in the honeycomb ceramic carrier industry, particularly strong in large-size carriers for heavy-duty diesel vehicles. It competes against global oligopolies dominated by Corning (USA) and NGK (Japan), which control over 90% of the global market. The company has broken domestic reliance on foreign suppliers by achieving key certifications and mass production capabilities, positioning itself as a key player in China’s emission control supply chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 332 million, a 63% increase year-over-year, driven by a recovery in the heavy-duty truck market. However, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 7.9 million, reflecting pressure from product mix changes, underutilized capacity, and increased costs. Total assets reached approximately RMB 1.48 billion with stable net assets around RMB 916 million. R&D investment accounted for 10.65% of revenue, underscoring a strong focus on innovation despite profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary and advanced honeycomb ceramic technology, particularly the andesine material with ultra-low thermal expansion and high durability, enabling compliance with stringent emission standards. Its integrated formula-mold-firing production system ensures high-quality, cost-effective products tailored for heavy-duty diesel vehicles and other industrial applications. The company’s regional proximity to key customers and its comprehensive product portfolio provide competitive advantages in supply reliability, technical support, and market responsiveness.
